explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/737: if χ(G) = ℵ₁, must some edge e lie on cycles of every sufficiently large length? Yes (Thomassen). ChromaticNumberAlephOne means colourable by the countable ordinals but not by ℕ, i.e. χ = ℵ₁. The statement asserts an edge e and N such that for all n ≥ N, G has a cycle of length n through e. Faithful.
